searchText: Are we expecting block explorer to be deployed in the first merge devnet? Any other tools that we'd like to have there, like ethstats? Would be a nice hackathon project to create a small explorer that captures the execution layer blocks vs the consensus blocks being produced Faucet would be nice Not on the first devnet, but definitely time to start integrating it <@!425572898787426305> ^ re explorer Have a small, goerli faucet that can be repurposed for merge needs here https://github.com/rauljordan/goerli-faucet We can do a faucet, we'll configure a few accounts in the genesis alloc, then fund a faucet with it (is there one configurable enough to send 32 eth, and avoid users repeating too often?) this would be really great 👍 How difficult would it be to re-configure it for the devnet? We aim the first devnet to last for a few days or a week, then it will likely be restarted with new client versions. all it needs is an eth1 http endpoint and the private key where the funds will be sent from. I can work on improving the usage soon too Can add dockerfiles, etc. Reminder: about 1h 20 min from now we'll do the 2nd rayonism office hours call here in discord. it would be really helpful if you could spend a time on it 👍 Great! will keep you guys posted and have it improved early this week Here is a draft of the first Merge devnet, the main goal now is to specify the scope of the spec that we're focusing in it. https://notes.ethereum.org/@n0ble/rayonism-mergenet-0 The doc references the one that <@!203220829473996800> has recently published about configuring test and dev nets and is heavily based on it. Mergenet is a stub-name, happy to change it to anything else 🙂 <@!203220829473996800> are you in contact with ETHGlobal? are they funneling anyone interested in working on eth2 / rayonism here? Getting "You don't have permission to access this resource. Sign in or head back to home" I dont think me and my team have an official ethereum login for hackmd 😦 <@!420951281910284289> Not actively chatting, but I do have some group chat to ask things. If you like to help out with comms, let's DM after the rayonism call. maybe it's as simple as getting the sponsor Role in the EG discord. Rayonism office hour call now It says im online and I need to request to speak? I invited you to speak, you can click accept fixed now https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/22641 New catalyst lol there have been semi-serious discussions about doing this for Goerli gETH <@456226577798135808>
